commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=$GITHUB_ACTIONS"; echo "CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR=$CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR"; git branch --show-current; git status --porcelain | head; ls .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/ 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
for phrase in "handoff, not a skip gate" "primary false-pass" "Why path-based loading" "Vestigial" "retained as a defensive guard" "Version-gap compatible" "confirmation-gated" "needs no loop-exit re-run" "CI is the validating gate" "Every drift incident" "Fix-induced defects" "Variance-recovered" "no longer commits observability"; do
  hits=$(grep -rn -F "$phrase" lib/test scripts 2>/dev/null | grep -v -F '.prflow/tmp')
  if [ -n "$hits" ]; then echo "=== PINN …[per-command-truncated]

RUN_URL="$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
BODY=$(printf 'Work in progress — automated review pending.

Resolves #1419
[View run](%s)

Generated via `/prflow:implement 1419`
' "$RUN_URL")
if CREATE_OUT=$(gh pr create --base main --draft --title "chore(skills): bring loop-exit.md and loop-control.md under the instruction-plus-consequence prose rule" --body "$BODY" 2>&1); then
  printf '%s
create: ok
' "$CREATE_OUT"
else
  printf '%s
create: failed
' "$CR …[per-command-truncated]

if CREATE_OUT=$(gh pr create --base main --draft --title "chore(skills): bring loop-exit.md and loop-control.md under the instruction-plus-consequence prose rule" --body-file .prflow/tmp/pr-body-1419.md 2>&1); then
  printf '%s\ncreate: ok\n' "$CREATE_OUT"
else
  printf '%s\ncreate: failed\n' "$CREATE_OUT"
fi

for p in "primary false-pass" "Version-gap compatible" "Every drift incident" "Why path-based loading" "Vestigial" "confirmation-gated" "dependency that makes that true"; do echo "== $p =="; grep -rn "$p" lib/test scripts 2>/dev/null | head; done
for f in loop-control loop-exit; do printf "%s " $f; sha256sum skills/review-and-fix/references/$f.md | cut -d' ' -f1; done

gh issue view 1419 --json body --jq '.body' > .prflow/tmp/docgate-1419.txt 2>&1
scripts/extract-doc-needed-paths.sh < .prflow/tmp/docgate-1419.txt; echo "extract-rc=$?"
echo "=== Documentation Needed section present? ==="
grep -qE '\*\*Documentation Needed\*\*|^###[[:space:]]+\*{0,2}Documentation Needed' .prflow/tmp/docgate-1419.txt && echo "PRESENT" || echo "ABSENT"
echo "=== tree clean? ==="
git status --porcelain; echo "rc=$?"

echo "=== reception-record.py ==="; scripts/reception-record.py --help 2>&1 | head -30
echo "=== checkout-fingerprint.py ==="; scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py --help 2>&1 | head -20

echo "=== reception-record record ==="; scripts/reception-record.py record 2>&1 | tail -20
echo "=== checkout-fingerprint ==="; scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py 2>&1 | tail -10

PR_STATE=$(scripts/config-get.sh .prflow_implement.implement_pr_state ready_for_review) || PR_STATE=ready_for_review
echo "PR_STATE=[$PR_STATE]"
if [ "$PR_STATE" = "draft" ]; then
  echo "OUTCOME=draft (leaving draft)"
elif gh pr ready 1429 2>&1; then
  echo "OUTCOME=published"
elif [ "$(gh pr view 1429 --json isDraft --jq '.isDraft' 2>/dev/null)" = "false" ]; then
  echo "OUTCOME=published (already non-draft)"
else
  echo "OUTCOME=publish_failed"
fi
scripts/workpad.py body $(scripts/workpad.py id 1419) 2>&1 | grep -m1 "Status:"; echo "=== PR state ==="; gh pr view 1429 --json state,isDraft,title --jq '{state,isDraft,title}'
